column1: # 1. Julia Juanico died at Montevideo on 11 July 1910, aged sixty-six. Born about 1844, she was about
#    twenty when she married Luis Eugenio Lerena Lenguas in December 1864. Everything fits.
# 2. She was a WIDOW. So LUIS EUGENIO LERENA LENGUAS DIED BEFORE 11 JULY 1910 - which narrows his death
#    to somewhere between 1880, when their last child was born, and July 1910. His own death record has
#    NOT been found; the search for it was cut short when FamilySearch firewalled this session.
# That also squares with their son Enrique's death registration of May 1914, which calls both parents
